content: {"phoneNote":"The hero card hangs off the photo's bottom edge and the footer repeats the full contact block already shown in the reservation section, with a huge 'Gostilna Pri mostu' wordmark that adds nothing.","desktopNote":"The hero card breaks out of the photo into a white band and leaves a dead strip, the price cards are stranded in a mostly empty maroon band, and the oversized footer wordmark repeats the brand a third time.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Keep the hero card inside the photo (or end the photo cleanly below it) so the card doesn't spill into a white band on both viewports.","Drop the giant footer wordmark and the duplicated address/phone/email in the footer; keep one compact legal line under the reservation block.","Tighten the price and family sections on desktop: narrower maroon band with the two offers side by side at a readable size, and let the interior photo share the first screen instead of sitting near the bottom."],"blockers":["Desktop and phone hero: the text card extends past the bottom of the photo into a blank white strip, so the layout reads as broken.","Phone and desktop footer: address, phone and e-mail repeat the reservation block directly above it."]}
